jobs.title: SDE - 2 Software Engineer
bullets: Built a reusable frontend SDK adopted by multiple teams across the organization, standardizing shared functionality and reducing duplicated effort.
Reduced JavaScript bundle chunk sizes through code splitting, lazy loading and dependency cleanup, improving page load performance.
Raised code quality standards by establishing linting rules, coding guidelines and stricter code review practices across the team.
Improved internal developer tools, streamlining day-to-day workflows and increasing team productivity.

jobs.title: SDE - 1 Frontend Engineer
bullets: Developed a comprehensive user portfolio tracking platform that enables users to synchronize their investment assets, including mutual funds and stocks, facilitating a centralized location for tracking and managing their holdings.

Introduced unit testing within the codebase, which significantly contributed to the team's ability to create comprehensive tests and proactively identify potential bugs during the early stages of development.
Enabled Smallcase transactions on the platform, providing users with the convenience of buying and selling Smallcases directly within the platform.
Used Next.js, React.js, Astro.js, TypeScript, Jest etc.

jobs.title: Frontend Intern
